title: Code for: Human fallopian tube-on-a-chip for preclinical testing of non-hormonal contraceptives with living human sperm
description:
MATLAB code and bead-tracking data for the paper Human fallopian tube-on-a-chip for preclinical testing of non-hormonal contraceptives with living human sperm (bioRxiv preprint, doi:10.64898/2026.01.22.700844).

  • cilia_different_sized_beads_emergent_dynamics.m: simulation of 5 µm and 100 µm bead movement with and without beating cilia, comparing mean squared displacement (MSD).
  • cilia_moving_stuffmlx.mlx: MATLAB live script with an MSD illustration (subdiffusive, diffusive and superdiffusive movement) and simulations of how bead size and cilia spacing affect bead diffusion.
  • Spot Data Analysis/: scripts that calculate MSD and plot trajectories of tracked 5 µm and 100 µm beads under three conditions ("Empty", "No Hormones", "2 nM E2"), together with the tracking data (CSV files and zip archives).
